package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

// Task status constants.
const (
	TaskStatusNoActive = 0
	TaskStatusActive   = 1
)

// Task represents coding task inside lesson.
type Task struct {
	ID                     string
	SourceKey              string
	LessonID               string
	Title                  string
	Description            string
	Translations           []TaskI18n
	LearningTargets        []TaskLearningTarget
	CodeStructureTypeID    string
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage
	ComposeConfigID        *string
	ComposeConfig          json.RawMessage
	ResolvedComposeConfig  json.RawMessage
	Type                   int16
	AssessmentPurpose      string
	ExecutionMode          int16
	EvaluationMode         int16
	UIMode                 int16
	SubmissionMode         int16
	RequiresSandbox        bool
	ExposesPreview         bool
	ExposesTerminal        bool
	SupportsLiveValidation bool
	AllowedErrorsCount     int
	Order                  int
	Status                 int
	Version                int
	CreatedAt              time.Time
	UpdatedAt              time.Time
	MaxAttempts            *int
	DeadlineAt             *time.Time
}

// TaskI18n stores localized task title/description.
type TaskI18n struct {
	TaskID      string `json:"task_id"`
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Language    string `json:"lang"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

// CodeStructureType describes structure type of task.
type CodeStructureType struct {
	ID               string
	Code             string
	Name             string
	Description      *string
	ValidatorService *string
	CreatedAt        time.Time
}
